transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I just can't shake this feeling that I've ruined things for everyone. I've fallen really behind at work, and I've kind of lost control of my apartment situation. It just feels like... like I deserve whatever bad thing happens next, you know? I just feel so guilty about all of it.
Have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying things that you usually like?

I don't think so. I mean, I still like the things I usually do. I still enjoy messing around with my computer setup or watching movies. I just... I guess I haven't been doing those things quite as much lately because of everything else going on, but the interest is definitely still there.
Have you recently gotten into fights, damaged property, or broken important rules because of what you’ve been going through?

No, nothing like that. I haven't been getting into fights or breaking any rules. I mean, I'm not really angry at anyone else, so I haven't lashed out or damaged anything. I mostly just keep to myself.
Did these feelings begin after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

Yeah, they did. It's been going on for... about a year and two months now. It all started when a pipe burst at my old place. It forced me to move into this smaller apartment, and... well, my routines just completely fell apart after that.
Have you been feeling depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. Most days I wake up with this... this flat, heavy sadness. It's just there all the time. It feels like the things that used to kind of reset me or make me feel better—like putting on a record, cooking dinner, or just tinkering with my electronics—they just don't reach me anymore. It's just a constant, heavy feeling almost every day.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do catch myself thinking sometimes that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. Like, if I just wasn't here, then nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy most days?

No, not really. I mean, I'm not bouncing off the walls, but I don't feel physically exhausted or anything. I can still get up and do what I need to do for work, I just... I just don't want to. But my energy levels seem pretty normal, I guess.
How has your sleep been lately?

Not great, honestly. I'll just lie there in bed for hours... mostly just listening for noises around the apartment. When I finally do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before dawn. And I wake up already feeling tense and exhausted. It's kind of like... like I never really powered down for the night.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions lately?

No, not really. I mean, my job is basically just troubleshooting computer issues all day, and I haven't really had any trouble figuring those out. I can still focus on what I need to do. I haven't noticed any problems making decisions, either.
